meta.name: story-import
meta.description: 逆向导入已有小说。将已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为标准项目目录结构，兼容 story-long-write / story-short-write 后续写作流程；内部复用 story-long-analyze / story-short-analyze 的拆解管道，按篇幅自动分流。触发方式：/story-import、「导入小说」「反向解析」「导入」「把我的书导进来」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将已有小说快速导入标准写作流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你有写好的小说想继续完善或纳入写作工具链
copy.tagline_en: Import existing novels into a structured writing workflow
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a written novel you want to refine or integrate into a writing toolchain

howto.what: 把已写好的小说（半成品或完本）反向解析为可续写的标准项目结构，自动按长篇/短篇分流，调用拆解管道生成拆文库，并迁移出设定、大纲、正文、追踪等文件。
howto.when: 当用户使用 /story-import、说出“导入小说”“反向解析”等触发词，或提供文件路径/粘贴正文时触发。

say.text: 导入《XX》这本小说，做成可续写的写作工程
say.note: 走完整导入流程，生成可续写的项目结构。

say.text: 我只想要拆文库分析，不用迁移成项目结构
say.note: 直接调用拆解管道，到拆文库为止。

say.text: 已有小说要续写，该先跑 setup 还是 import？
say.note: 先回答流程顺序，再收集原文。

howto.what_en: Reverse-imports an existing novel (partial or complete) into a standard writable project structure; auto-routes by length, runs the analysis pipeline to produce a 拆文库, then migrates settings, outline, text, and tracking files.
howto.when_en: Triggered by /story-import, by trigger phrases such as “导入小说” / “反向解析”, or when the user provides a file path or pastes novel text.

say_en.text: Import this novel and make it a writable project.
say_en.note: Runs full import and builds continuation-ready structure.

say_en.text: I only want the analysis output, no project migration.
say_en.note: Calls the analyze pipeline and stops at 拆文库.

say_en.text: Should I run story-setup or story-import first?
say_en.note: Answers the workflow order, then asks for the source.
